question.text: The number of <math><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">p</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> hybrid orbitals in a molecule of benzene is:

solution.text: In benzene total six <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>sp</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> hybrid carbon atoms are present .Each carbon atom has <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>sp</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> hybrid orbitals. Therefore total <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>sp</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></math> hybrid orbitals are 18 in benzene.
